biotools.summary: A CLI tool for detecting duplicate DICOM images by analyzing pixel data, generating content-based hashes, and comparing them to identify identical images, even when metadata, file format, or size differs. Supports large datasets, LMDB-based indexing, and multiple operation modes for flexible workflows.
